sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 5 Appointment of Provincial Ministers Oath of Office Amendment Order 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 5 OF 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 5 OF
2002
APPOINTMENT OF PROVINCIAL
MINISTERS AND OATH OF OFFICE (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002 .
(An order to amend the
Appointment of Provincial Ministers and Oath of Office Order, 1999)
No.2‑25/99‑Min.II,
dated 25‑2‑2002.
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Appointment of Provincial Ministers and Oath of Office Order, 1999 (Chief
Executive's Order No.8 of 1999), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of Emergency of the fourteenth day of October, 1999, and
Provisional Constitution Order No.1 of 1999, and in exercise of all powers
enabling him in that behalf, the Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic of
Pakistan is pleased to make and promulgate the following Order:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Order may be called the Appointment of
Provincial Ministers and Oath o Office (Amendment) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

dated 25‑2‑2002.
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Appointment of Provincial Ministers and Oath of Office Order, 1999 (Chief
Executive's Order No.8 of 1999), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of Emergency of the fourteenth day of October, 1999, and
Provisional Constitution Order No.1 of 1999, and in exercise of all powers
enabling him in that behalf, the Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic of
Pakistan is pleased to make and promulgate the following Order:‑‑
2. Amendment of Schedule,
Chief Executive's Order No. 8 of 1999.‑‑‑In the
Appointment of Provincial Ministers and Oath of Office Order, 1999 (Chief
Executive's Order No.8 of 1999), in the Schedule, in the third paragraph for
the words, commas and figure "issued by the Chairman Joint Chiefs of Staff
Committee, Chief of Army Staff and the Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic
of Pakistan on the Fourteenth day of October, 1999 and all subsequent Orders
issued by him the words "and all subsequent Orders made or issued by the
Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan" shall be substituted.
